headline: A disaster for Justice
dek: The President attacks the Governor of California, calling him “Newscum”, for halting the death penalty for the 563 inmates on California’s death row. Switzerland has reviewed the request.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Gavin Newscum’s halting the Death Penalty for all 563 California Death Row inmates, some of the worst cold blooded murderers to have ever lived on the face of the Earth, is a disaster for Justice in America. Many of these names, people who have killed, over and over again, can’t believe their luck in having a Governor so incompetent and insensitive that he would not let the long and winding legal system prevail. The family members of those who were so viciously killed are, rightfully, devastated. Hopefully this decision will be overturned! President DONALD J. TRUMP
original.key: Gavin Newscum’s halting the Death Penalty for all 563 California Death Row inmates, some of the worst cold blooded murderers to have ever lived on the face of the Earth, is a disaster for Justice in America.
original.context: Posted on 14 November 2026. “Newscum” is the President’s nickname for Gavin Newsom, the Governor of California. Our versions are about the tone of the debate, never about the crimes or the victims.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 14 November 2026 (shown as 11/14/26, 6:54 AM Pacific).

en: Switzerland takes note of the disagreement.
We abolished the death penalty in 1942, so on this one we may not be entirely neutral.
But we are neutral about names. His is Newsom.
neutral.key: But we are neutral about names. His is Newsom.
